### 2. **"happy" Installation**

**Location:** `/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml` (lines 1041-1058)

**Installation Method:** npm package `happy-coder`

```yaml
- name: Check if Happy is installed
  when: npm_check.rc == 0
  ansible.builtin.command: which happy
  register: happy_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install Happy (npm)
  when:
    - npm_check.rc == 0
    - happy_check.rc != 0
  community.general.npm:
    name: happy-coder
    global: true
    state: present
  ignore_errors: true
```

**Notes:**
- Installed globally via npm
- Part of the `coding_agents` ansible role (optional, controlled by `installCodingAgents` prompt)
- Only installs if npm is available

### 5. **"tmuxp" Installation**

**Location:** `/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/python_uv_tools/defaults/main.yml` (line 32-33)

**Installation Method:** Python package via `uv tool install`

```yaml

```

**How it installs (from tasks/main.yml):**
```yaml
- name: Install Python CLI tools via uv
  ansible.builtin.command: >-
    uv tool install {{ item.name }}
    {% if item.python is defined %}--python {{ item.python }} {% endif %}
    {% if item.with is defined %}{% for dep in item.with %}--with {{ dep }} {% endfor %}{% endif %}
  args:
    creates: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/{{ item.binary }}"
  loop: "{{ python_uv_tools }}"
```

**Notes:**
- Installed via `uv tool install tmuxp`
- Binary location: `~/.local/bin/tmuxp`
- Part of `python_uv_tools` ansible role (optional, controlled by `installPythonUvTools` prompt)
- Cross-platform (works on all profiles)

    10→- [chezmoi](https://www.chezmoi.io/install/)

    14→
    15→```mermaid
    16→flowchart TB

    18→        BREW[Homebrew macOS]

    24→        DOT[Config files<br/>~/.gitconfig, ~/.config/]

    27→    end
    28→

    30→        BASE[base]

    32→        NVIM[neovim]

    36→    end
    37→
    38→    subgraph BrewBundle["4. Brew Bundle opt-in"]
    39→        CASKS[GUI Apps]
    40→        MAS[App Store]
    41→    end
    42→
    43→    Bootstrap --> Chezmoi --> Ansible
    44→    Chezmoi -.-> BrewBundle
    45→    MISE -.->|Node.js, Rust| NVIM
    46→    MISE -.->|Rust| CARGO
    47→    UV -.->|Python tools| UVTOOLS
    48→    BREW -.->|casks| CASKS
    49→```
    50→
    51→## Quick Setup
    52→
    53→```bash
    54→# One-liner to initialize and apply (installs chezmoi to ~/.local/bin)
    55→export GITHUB_USERNAME=daviddwlee84
    56→sh -c "$(curl -fsLS get.chezmoi.io)" -- -b "$HOME/.local/bin" init --apply git@github.com:$GITHUB_USERNAME/dotfiles.git
    57→```
    58→
    59→This automatically:
    60→
    61→1. Bootstraps Homebrew (macOS/Linux), uv, mise, ansible
    62→2. Deploys all config files
    63→3. Runs ansible playbooks (git, ripgrep, fd, neovim, etc.)
    64→4. Runs brew bundle (if `installBrewApps` enabled)
    65→
    66→### Optional Components
    67→
    68→During `chezmoi init`, you'll be prompted for optional installs:
    69→
    70→| Option | Default | Description |
    71→|--------|---------|-------------|
    72→| `installCodingAgents` | true | Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, td, sidecar, specify-cli, etc. |
    73→| `installBitwarden` | false | Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) + Desktop app (desktop profiles) with SSH agent auto-detection |
    74→| `installPythonUvTools` | true | Python CLI tools via uv (mlflow, litellm, sqlit-tui, etc.) |
    75→| `installBrewApps` | false | GUI apps via Homebrew Brewfile (casks, mas) |
    76→| `installInputMethod` | false | Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME/Squirrel on macOS; ibus-rime on Linux) |
    77→| `noRoot` | false | Skip sudo-requiring tasks (for servers without root access) |
    78→
    79→To change options later: `chezmoi init --force`
    80→
    81→## What You Get

    83→### Config Files
    84→
    85→- `~/.gitconfig` - Git configuration
    86→- `~/.config/nvim/` - Neovim (LazyVim) configuration
    87→- `~/.config/uv/uv.toml` - uv package manager config
    88→- `~/.cargo/config.toml` - Cargo registry mirror config (GFW)
    89→- `~/.npmrc` - npm registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
    90→- `~/.config/.bunfig.toml` - Bun global registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
    91→- `~/.config/alacritty/` - Alacritty terminal config
    92→- `~/.config/starship.toml` - Starship cross-shell prompt config
    93→- `~/.config/direnv/direnvrc` - direnv helper functions, including `.venv`-aware Python activation
    94→- `~/.config/yazi/` - Yazi file manager config (v0.3.3+ syntax, [docs](https://yazi-rs.github.io/docs/configuration/overview/))
    95→  - `yazi.toml` - Main config with open rules and openers (`o`/`O`)
    96→  - `keymap.toml`, `theme.toml` - Optional customization files (stubs provided)
    97→- `~/.claude/` - Claude Code settings
    98→- `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` - Global SpecStory defaults for `specstory run` across all projects
    99→- `~/.tmux.conf` - Tmux configuration with TPM plugins
   100→- `~/.local/bin/x` - Cross-platform terminal wrapper for `copy` / `paste` / `open`

- **Profiles:** `ubuntu_server`, `ubuntu_desktop`, `macos`, `macos_intel`
- **Feature Toggles:** Brewfile installation, coding agents, Python tools, Bitwarden, input methods
- **No-root mode:** For servers without sudo access
- **GFW mirror support:** For users in China
